title: Fix `copy`, `deepcopy` and `pickle` of `Sentinel` members
body: Just a small issue I encountered on Python 3.10, where `Enum` has no `__deepcopy__`. Now that every parameter have a sentinel, `copy.deepcopy()` of any `Option`, `Argument` or `Command` fails on Python 3.10. And `pickle` fails on every Python version. This PR fix this issue.
author: kdeldycke
